change: After normal runtime maintenance, binding, buffered-event and pending-replay checks, poll gives one SUB receive a chance before a due synchronous head request. A due deadline makes receive nonblocking. A validated continuous event may return first; absent/ignored/duplicate frames still reach the due head check. Gap failures cannot retry head in the same poll once recovery is required.
contract: Head interval schedules idle checks, not a hard freshness deadline. A continuously valid stream may defer periodic head checks; gaps or idle polls still trigger recovery. Existing lease/binding/epoch/queue/page-budget guards remain.

Independent review found the untested due+gap+head-failure retry path; source/test snapshots and the original passing result were preserved. Final focused run includes its distinguishing regression.
